verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing's REST API supports core card-program actions an agent would need: creating/updating cards (docs-15,29,11,16), activating/suspending/closing (docs-10,17-19,30), and adjusting spend controls via transaction rules (docs-3,23), plus transaction/webhook data (docs-25,28,35). However there is no evidence of an MCP surface, no explicit 'read balance/transaction' read endpoints, and no documentation of scoped API-key credentials tailored for autonomous agent use. missing for 10: MCP server/tool surface, explicit balance/transaction GET endpoints, scoped-credential/agent-auth documentation, independent confirmation of agent usage.
